findings: Inactive client contacts block reuse — create_client and update_client query all clients with a non-null pic_contact and apply no is_active filter. A deactivated client's phone numbers permanently block those numbers from being assigned to a new or existing client. If the intended policy is 'contacts must be unique across active clients only', add .filter(Client.is_active == True) to both queries.

onSubmit unhandled rejection — onSubmit calls await onCreate / await onUpdate via mutateAsync with no surrounding try/catch. React Hook Form's handleSubmit suppresses async errors from the submit handler so the UI won't crash, but the reliance is implicit and version-dependent. Adding an empty catch makes the intent explicit.
